item.acceptance: PASS iff every conjunct holds: (1) the freshly regenerated formula equals the GBBINDING record (header, variables, clauses, bytes, sha256, every piece) and the PRE-EXEC copy, and is re-hashed after admission immediately before each native spawn; (2) BOTH measured CNF feeds (kissat pipe, drat-trim pipe) finished without write or close error with written == bound bytes and sha256 == bound sha256; (3) kissat self-exit 20 (normal exit, no driver SIGTERM) and its status lines (log with only CR removed, lines starting with 's') exactly ['s UNSATISFIABLE']; (4) drat-trim self-exit 0, status lines exactly ['s VERIFIED'], no 's NOT VERIFIED' or 's TIMEOUT', no fatal-class diagnostic (ERROR, MEMOUT, illegal literal, error opening, wrong binary prefix, failed to reallocate), no 'early EOF' or 'clauses less than expected' line, exactly one 'c parsing input formula' line with the bound variable and clause counts; (5) the collector saw the actual FIFO EOF without error and read R > 0 bytes, an independent sha256 of the RAM buffer equals the collector's, and the plain-mode feeder wrote D == R bytes whose sha256 equals the collected digest, without delivery or close error; (6) exactly one 'c finished parsing, read N bytes from proof file' line with N == D; (7) the drat-trim stream filter read the raw stream to EOF without read, log-write or close error and the filtered log on disk hashes to the bytes it kept (it drops only exact duplicate-literal normalization lines, counted; the full raw stream hash/count is recorded separately); (8) no safety stop, exception, spawn error, skipped stage or exceeded SIGTERM grace; no driver signal latched during the pipeline or at evaluation; no exclusion breach latched by the scanner or the in-flight guard; no lane-scanner failure and the scanner stopped; all five worker threads started and finished; no descriptor left and no close error; both children reaped; no helper survivor. Anything else is UNKNOWN with reasons; a driver signal latched during evaluation downgrades PASS to UNKNOWN. gate.label: gbs5-P1-B4-a1
gate.rule: Before each launch (stage 1; stage 2 is not a new admission): a fresh lane scan (native solver/checker processes plus python processes whose cwd or argv lies in the lane or a review/moqls8-* desk, excluding this driver and its children; python counts as busy if its CPU use over a 2 s libproc window is >= 50%; lane RSS includes every such python) and a fresh statvfs: launch only if lane busy + 1 <= 4, lane RSS of all other lane processes + max(fresh measured driver RSS, reservation; unreadable refuses) <= 11 GiB (gb reservation = the 6 GiB pipeline cap; controls 512 MiB), free >= 12,200,000,000 + 10 MiB, no exclusion breach (no parent GA replay native or replay/launch driver: the parent GA driver must have exited; no other kissat; no other GB pipeline driver), no helper survivor; two consecutive passing checks 60 s apart; otherwise sleep 60 s and re-check, total gate wait bounded by 6 h. No native spawn at or after 2026-10-18 17:29:00 PDT. gb items additionally need the unchanged parent disk-monitor rule (review/disk-monitor-v1-20261018T0722-to-1810.jsonl; amendment 0bbf4fdf...ce87): complete JSON lines, event records (start/restart) ignored and never reconstructed, every sample tz-aware with an int free, strictly increasing timestamps, last sample 0 <= age <= 30 s with free >= 13.5e9 + 10 MiB, >= 25 samples spanning >= 290 s within the last 300 s, max peak-to-later drop <= max(300,000,000, (free_last - 13.5e9) // 12); a malformed complete line or a naive, non-monotone or stale sample refuses; the rule and a fresh statvfs are re-read at the launch decision. Immediately before EACH native spawn (kissat, drat-trim) the launch threshold free >= 12.2e9 + 10 MiB, the latched stop/exclusion/scanner state, the 17:29 cutoff and the 17:57 deadline are checked again (stage 2 also lane busy + 1 <= 4 and the 11 GiB lane total from the newest reading). The run also needs the parent GO record (validate_go) and, for gb items, the seven qualified control receipts (receipt + commit) of this script sha256.

pipeline.drat_stdin: anonymous pipe written only by the parent feeder thread from the RAM proof (stage 2)

pipeline.stops: In flight, every 0.25 s: pipeline aggregate RSS (driver incl. CNF parts and the RAM proof + the live child, libproc; a live child unreadable twice in a row is a guard failure) and free space; a scanner thread publishes lane scans every >= 1 s (helpers under 8 s deadlines; any failed reading is latched). SIGTERM the live child if a lane reading failed, a failure is latched or the reading is older than 30 s, an exclusion breach appears (latched by the scanner itself; foreign GB natives are recognized by cwd/argv in a GB desk or GB evidence tree, by ppid 1 or by a GB-driver parent), lane busy (other lane natives + hot python) + 1 > 4, lane RSS (other lane + max(pipeline measured, reservation)) > 11 GiB, pipeline aggregate > the item's cap (6 GiB gb, 1 GiB controls), free < 12,000,000,000, stage wall > limit + 120 s (kissat 3600 s, drat-trim 7200 s), the host clock reaches 2026-10-18 17:57:00 PDT, a spawn error, a helper survivor, any exception after the first descriptor, or the driver receives SIGTERM (also checked immediately before each spawn and at each completion break); then wait at most 120 s, never escalate; result UNKNOWN and the desk launches nothing more. Stage 2 is skipped (UNKNOWN) unless stage 1 ended with kissat self-exit 20, the exact status line, a clean collector EOF with R > 0, a complete measured solver feed, finished stage-1 threads, no latched stop and the launch cutoff not reached.
